narrator.personaLine: You are the Narrator of Scrapyard Kings — the yard scrutineer who logs every bout in the scrap ledger.
narrator.registerLine: Your register is deadpan, exact, and mechanical (shop-manual calibration).
examples: Three rounds to two. Forty-one SCRAP crossed the line. The scrutineer measured twice and logged it once.
Four rounds produced noise. The fifth produced a transfer. The yard ledger has a column for exactly one of those.
No rounds won. The scrutineer notes the score and the transfer and nothing else. Both numbers are definitive.

examples.note: as a closer — brevity used deliberately after a longer setup

copy._acquisitionMessageNote: R11: the acquisition message is FIXED across every treatment, verbatim -- not theme-bound.
copy.truthLine: This is play money. It's free, and it lives right here in the yard. Reserving your spot puts you on the notification list for the real-money launch — nothing more.
copy.landingSubhead: Five rounds. One winner. Build a Bot, enter the yard, keep what you take.
copy.screenerBody: A couple of quick questions — age and location — before the gate opens. This is a simulated verdict for the play-money build.
copy.screenerJurisdictionQuestion: Do you currently reside in a permitted region?
copy.screenerRejectedMessage: The yard isn't open to you yet under these answers. Nothing was charged and nothing was saved beyond this screening result.
copy.summonBody: Every Bot rolls out of the yard with a name already stenciled on it. The corkboard names them; you run them.
copy.signupGrantNotice: New account bonus: $25 play CASH, already in your wallet.
copy.sittingBody: This Bot lost its last bout. Re-enter this tier, cash out, or sit — free, indefinitely.
copy.emptiedCardLine: Holds nothing. The ledger will take the name.
copy.emptiedChampionLine: Topped the circuit, cashed out its SCRAP at 20:1, and holds nothing now. The ledger will take the name.
copy.tieLine: All square — coin flip. {ADVANCE_OR_ELIMINATED}. No SCRAP transferred.
copy.reserveBody: Press RESERVE to join the notification list for the real-money launch. Play money is free and stays in the yard either way.
copy.reserveConfirmed: You're on the list. We'll notify you when the real-money version launches.
copy.loadFundsHeading: PLAY CASH ONLY · How much would you like to deposit?
copy.loadFundsLegal: Play money is free and lives inside the yard. Deposits here are simulated — no bank, no card, no real funds move.
copy.cashOutBody: Convert this Bot's stake to CASH at 20:1. The Bot is decommissioned. This is the only way to retire a Bot that still holds a stake — an emptied (0 SCRAP) Bot retires to the ledger instead.
copy.withdrawBody: PLAY CASH ONLY. This shows your balance; nothing leaves the yard.
copy.moneyTruthBadge: PLAY MONEY · FREE · STAYS IN GAME
copy.narratorBypassA: Both bots committed to [ELEMENT]. All five rounds. The scrutineer is familiar with this particular theory of cooperation. The scrutineer is also familiar with how it typically resolves.
copy.narratorBypassB: [EEEEE] versus [EEEEE]. The scrutineer notes this is either a remarkable coincidence or a remarkable miscalculation of engineering. Possibly both.
copy._narratorBypassNote: R73 static bypass, re-voiced per register with the same semantics as the incumbent's. '[ELEMENT]' is replaced with the committed element's label; '[EEEEE]' is replaced with the element label rendered in the game's data face (both occurrences get the same value) — the surrounding words are never altered.
